cd /workspace && export OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 && LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$PWD/native" PYTHONPATH="$PWD/.deps" python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,random,json
sys.path.insert(0,'submission');sys.path.insert(0,'tmp')
from protocol import validate
from te.session import run_case
import gen_replay_test as g
random.seed(20251113)
adv=wait=acc=inf=obs=sup=dup=0
for trial in range(500):
    ncases=random.choices([0,1,1,1,2,3],[1,4,5,5,2,1])[0]
    cases=[g.gen_case(i,trial%2) for i in range(ncases)]
    req={'cases':cases};validate(req)
    out={'cases':[run_case(c) for c in cases]}
    for c,cout in zip(cases,out['cases']):
        for ev,res in zip(c['events'],cout['events']):
            if ev['op']=='step':
                if res['status']=='advanced':adv+=1
                else:wait+=1
            if ev['op']=='deliver':
                acc+=res['status']=='accepted';inf+=res['status']=='infeasible';obs+=res['status']=='obsolete';sup+=res['status']=='superseded';dup+=res['status']=='duplicate'
print(dict(adv=adv,wait=wait,acc=acc,inf=inf,obs=obs,sup=sup,dup=dup))
PY
